name: jamstack-expert
description: Tailwind CSS, Eleventy/Build Awesome, Nunjucks, Alpine.js, JAMstack version-audit, and static-first frontend repository expertise.

interface.longDescription: A local plugin that equips Codex with static-first JAMstack workflows: inline Tailwind utility styling, Eleventy and Nunjucks architecture, lightweight Alpine.js progressive enhancement, and repo-aware version auditing. It wires documentation MCPs that resolve current framework references at use time.
defaultPrompt: Use JAMstack Expert on this 11ty/Tailwind repo.
Make this UI with inline Tailwind utilities.
Audit this JAMstack repo for stale dependencies.
